item.title: GRID4EARTH
item.description:
GRID4EARTH is an ESA Digital Twin Earth activity building a unified, standardized data infrastructure based on Discrete Global Grid Systems (DGGS)—HEALPix and Zarr—for Copernicus Sentinel and Destination Earth data.

Project site →

Consortium: IFREMER, CNRS, Simula, University of Tartu, GEORODE.

item.title: WaterSmartLand
item.description:
WaterSmartLand is an ERC Consolidator Grant developing a framework to find spatially optimal land management for nature-based solutions (wetlands, riparian buffer strips) to reduce agricultural nutrient runoff. It uses a DGGS data cube, machine learning, and process-based hydrological modelling.

Project site →

Led by Prof. Evelyn Uuemaa at the University of Tartu (2024–2029).

Overview

  1. The Hugo Blox website builder for Hugo, along with its starter templates, is designed for professional creators, educators, and teams/organizations - although it can be used to create any kind of site
  2. The template can be modified and customised to suit your needs. It’s a good platform for anyone looking to take control of their data and online identity whilst having the convenience to start off with a no-code solution (write in Markdown and customize with YAML parameters) and having flexibility to later add even deeper personalization with HTML and CSS
  3. You can work with all your favourite tools and apps with hundreds of plugins and integrations to speed up your workflows, interact with your readers, and much more
